'''Meridat Stato''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A merchant like her relatives [[Felusia Stato|Felusia]], [[Nelva Stato|Nelva]], and [[Clem Stato|Clem]], Meridat Stato sold furniture and decorations on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Decorations vendor who appears on the Imperial Fleet, Meridat Stato was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']]. While her fellow merchants Clem Stato and [[Estah Kloy]] appear on both the Imperial and Republic Fleets, Meridat Stato is replaced by Nelva Stato on the Republic Fleet.<ref name="TOR" />
